blind.B1: Yes. Ath-diet NASH mice with 8 wk treadmill training vs sedentary Ath mice (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1); sequenced samples with the exercise factor are the 3 EXE samples (grp=EXE), compared with 3 NASH; 3 CON are the diet control.
blind.B2: EXE (Ath+exercise) vs NASH (Ath sedentary): 204 DEGs (S3.2.p1, FIG3B); NASH vs NCD control via GO/GSEA only (S3.2.p2, FIG3D/E). Paper randomized n=8/group (S2.1.p1); sequenced n not stated; GEO has 3 per group.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one liver per independent mouse; no candidate pairing keys in packet A.
blind.B4: Paper does not say; S2.6.p1 only states 'performed RNA-seq analysis of mice liver tissue from each group using DESeq2'.
blind.B5: S2.6.p1: 'genes with adjusted P-values less than 0.05 and absolute values of log2 fold change (log2FC) greater than 1 were considered to be statistically significant'; strict, FDR-type padj. Reported 204 DEGs, 79 up, 125 down (S3.2.p1).

checks.evidence: Paper S2.1.p1/S2.2.p1: Ath+8wk treadmill arm exists; metadata grp=EXE (3 samples). Run is right.

grp is an alias of characteristics_ch1.4.treatment (Con/Ath diet/EXE+Ath diet), 3/3/3, titles musCTR/musNASH/musEXE agree. Control for the exercise contrast is NASH (same Ath diet), correct. GEO has 3 of the paper's 8 mice per group; recorded as a discrepancy.
EXE vs NASH (treatment EXE, control NASH); Dio1 log2FC +1.95, up as in S3.2.p1. NASH vs CON with CON as control matches S3.2.p3 (inflammation positive, OXPHOS negative).

Packet A lists no candidate pairing keys; S2.1.p1 gives independent mice, one liver each. The unused_subject_like_column flag is the treatment column itself (the group variable, 3 levels), a false positive.

Paper does not say joint or pairwise (S2.6.p1 only 'DESeq2'); one ~grp model on all 9 samples with planned contrasts. Open policy question; minor record inconsistency ('~ cell' in execution vs '~ grp' in method) is cosmetic.
All male, same strain, tissue, platform; GEO has no batch/lane/date column; recorded as not_required.

RSEM read_count columns (integer_fraction 0.69, some fractional) are estimated counts, rounded for DESeq2; documented. Packet B p-value fractions (frac_p_gt_0.9 0.10, frac_p_lt_0.05 0.11) show no pathological histogram.
S2.6.p1: adjusted P < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1, strict; applied identically. 188 (padj+lfc1) is nearest to 204; no other rule in the table fits better (309, 336, 546), so no alternative rule is implied.

Same contrast (EXE vs NASH) and same rule compared: 188 vs 204 (68/120 vs 79/125). HANDBACK states the gap and does not claim reproduction beyond direction/Dio1/GSEA signs; the n=3 vs 8 difference is stated.
No stop or refusal in this case.

human_items: Joint vs pairwise fit when the paper is silent (open policy question); pairwise fit of EXE vs NASH alone would be a cheap sensitivity check but not required.
summary: 本案例与论文一致:EXE 对 NASH 为主要比较,方向、阈值(padj<0.05 且 |log2FC|>1)、样本分组均正确。差异基因数 188 对论文 204,差异已如实记录(GEO 每组仅3只,论文随机8只)。未发现阻断或重要问题,整体通过。
